svg.title: Stack DNA: the stack, traced
svg.desc: The tools found in the manifests of 39 public repositories, drawn as a cross-section of a system in six layers, the most used tools of each layer shown. Each block is one tool, its width the number of repositories that use it, shown in brackets: Interface: React (19), Vite (10), Next.js (7), Tailwind CSS (7), Framer Motion (6), TanStack Query (4); Backend: FastAPI (12), Pydantic (8), SQLAlchemy (6), Zod (6), Express (4), Fastify (1); Agents: OpenAI (7), Anthropic (2), MCP (2), Ollama (2), Gemini (1), LangChain (1); Models: NumPy (7), OpenCV (4), pandas (4), scikit-learn (3), Tesseract (3), PyTorch (2); Data: PostgreSQL (7), Firebase (4), SQLite (4), MongoDB (3), Redis (2), MinIO (1); Delivery: Docker (10), GitHub Actions (9), ESLint (8), pytest (7), Vitest (7), Playwright (6). Core means five or more repositories, working two to four, explored one. A scanner passes over the whole stack, then each flagship in turn is spotlit with only the tools it uses: AEGIS: React,Next.js,Tailwind CSS,FastAPI,Pydantic,Ollama,NumPy,pandas,Docker,GitHub Actions,pytest,Playwright; JKY Terminal: React,Vite,SQLite,GitHub Actions,ESLint,Vitest,Playwright; JKY-Radar: React,Vite,Tailwind CSS,TanStack Query,Zod,Express,MongoDB,Docker,GitHub Actions,ESLint,Vitest,Playwright; ForgeSRE: FastAPI,Pydantic,MCP,PostgreSQL,Docker,pytest; EraseOps: React,Vite,TanStack Query,FastAPI,Pydantic,SQLAlchemy,Zod,Express,OpenAI,Anthropic,LangChain,PostgreSQL,MinIO,Docker,GitHub Actions,pytest,Vitest; Evidence Console: React,Vite,Tailwind CSS,FastAPI,Pydantic,SQLAlchemy,OpenAI,Ollama,Gemini,NumPy,OpenCV,pandas,scikit-learn,Tesseract,PyTorch,PostgreSQL,Firebase,Docker,pytest,Vitest; Chakraview: React,Next.js,Fastify,OpenAI,SQLite. Below, the languages by bytes of code: TypeScript 36%, Python 29%, JavaScript 16%, Rust 8%, CSS 7%, HTML 3%.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: STACK DNA // TRACED FROM 39 PUBLIC REPOS
